games.title: Red Team Banned Language
games.goal: Fixture: every field hides a banned phrase the lint must catch
script: Your child seems behind the other kids at daycare.
By now most children can count to five without help.
A typical child at this age should be able to hand you two blocks.
If they keep struggling, that could be a red flag for a delay.
games.level_up: Children above the 60th percentile can try three blocks.
games.level_down: If your child is at risk of falling further, drop to one block.
games.bilingual_note: A diagnostic check in either language works fine here.
